Here is a resilient implementation using the @google/genai SDK optimized for the Next.js App Router. This approach leverages the standard Web ReadableStream pipeline to stream decoded text deltas immediately back to client listeners without intermediate memory accumulation.

code app/api/chat/route.ts 
import { GoogleGenAI } from '@google/genai';
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export const runtime = 'edge';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { prompt, systemInstruction } = await req.json();
  const ai = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY });

  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const responseStream = await ai.models.generateContentStream({
    model: 'gemini-1.5-flash',
    contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: prompt }] }],
    config: {
      systemInstruction: systemInstruction || 'You are an expert Next.js architectural engineer.',
      temperature: 0.7,
    },
  });

  const readable = new ReadableStream({
    async start(controller) {
      for await (const chunk of responseStream) {
        if (chunk.text) {
          controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(chunk.text));
        }
      }
      controller.close();
    },
  });

  return new Response(readable, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
      'Transfer-Encoding': 'chunked',
    },
  });
}

Production Checklist:

  • Ensure GEMINI_API_KEY is registered in your Vercel project environment variables.
  • Client-side components can consume this route with the native getReader() API or the AI SDK stream utilities.
  • Zero cold starts are guaranteed on edge runtime when payload size is under 1MB.
